items.summary: Implement a backend API `getCallerUserRole()` that returns the caller role as a text value compatible with the frontend checks (e.g., "admin", "user", "guest"). Use the existing authorization/access-control state already included in `backend/main.mo` (MixinAuthorization + AccessControl).

Implement a backend API for YouTube subscription verification that the frontend mutation `useSetYouTubeVerified` can call (e.g., `setYouTubeVerified()`), which updates the caller's `UserProfile` by setting `isYouTubeVerified = true` and setting `youtubeVerificationTimestamp = ?Time.now()` without requiring the frontend to pass any parameters.

Add backend suggestion APIs backed by the existing `suggestions` map in `backend/main.mo`: (1) submit a suggestion (author text + feedback text, assign incremental id + timestamp), (2) list all suggestions with total count, and (3) delete a suggestion by id (admin-only). Ensure the return shape for listing matches the existing backend type `SuggestionsResponse` ({ suggestions : [Suggestion]; count : Nat }).

Add backend comment APIs backed by the existing `comments` map in `backend/main.mo`: (1) list comments for a given `questionId`, (2) post a comment for a question (text, assigns incremental id, stores caller principal as userId, sets timestamp), and (3) delete a comment by id. Deletion must be allowed for admins; non-admin deletion must be rejected. Use the existing public `Comment` type in `backend/main.mo` for compatibility.
